page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, a column of small marginal notes running from top to bottom, with reference marks; page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: animatus, & spe bonâ fultus secretò primum cum amicis, dein paulatim cum pluribus agens, aliosque post alios ad causam adjungens, præsertim optimates, ad capessendam rem omnibus salutarem eos exsuscitavit. Demum cum res jam matura videretur, jussit xxx primores die illucescente cum armis in forum se conferre ad consternandos, metuque turbandos adversarios. Vnde cum tumultus aliquis existeret, Charilaus rex perculsus, metuens in se arma versum iri, (id enim ei Lycurgi æmuli, & causæ inimici insufurrabant,) in sacellum Minervæ, quod Chalciacum dicebant, velut in asylum[illegible, ~8 letters] confugit. Sed fretus jurejurando sibi dato, relicto sacello, & re plenius cognita partibus Lycurgi accessit, uti ferebat ingenium ejus manfuetissimum.[illegible, ~6 letters] Xenophon scribit, existimare se, haud levibus rationibus ductum, non prius[illegible, ~6 letters] ad constituendam rempublicam & leges ferendas Lycurgum aggressum esse, quam eos, qui in civitate plurimum valerent, consentientes reddidisset. Deinde addit, non ante leges eum populo tradidisse, quam cum civium præstantissimis Delphos profectus Deum interrogasset, an Spartæ melius futurum esset, si legibus à se conceptis parerent,[illegible, ~10 letters] respor[?]

page.notes: The right margin holds about eight small marginal notes with reference marks and symbols, printed very small and partly hidden by the scan's ornaments; they cannot be read reliably, so they are marked illegible at their approximate positions. The last line ends with "respor" and the rest of the word is hidden by a mark in the margin, so the word is given as "respor[?]". The "Demum" line carries a printer's mark that is not text and is left out. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
